# Apple iPhone Event September 2026: iPhone Fold, iPhone 18 Pro and More

Kreso | 27/08/2026 | Apple | No Comments

Apple has officially confirmed the date for its 2026 fall iPhone event: Wednesday, September 9. The presentation will carry the tagline “Surprise and shine” and will mark the company’s first major product keynote under new CEO John Ternus, who is set to take over from Tim Cook on September 1. [...] Although the keynote will not be delivered live on stage, Apple typically publishes the recording immediately after the premiere, allowing viewers to watch on demand.

## How to watch the iPhone 18 event

Apple's event kicks off Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. PT / 1:00 p.m. ET at the Steve Jobs Theater at Apple Park, with a livestream on Apple's website and YouTube channel for those not attending in person.

Mashable will be there on the ground, so look out for our coverage and hands-on impressions once the keynote wraps.
